As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
I who am myself one of the rulers of the church, and a witness of the death of Christ, having my part in the coming glory, send this serious request to the chief men among you:
我這作長老、作基督受苦的見證、同享後來所要顯現之榮耀的，勸你們中間與我同作長老的人：
Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is God’s will; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
Keep watch over the flock of God which is in your care, using your authority, not as forced to do so, but gladly; and not for unclean profit but with a ready mind;
務要牧養在你們中間神的群羊，按著神旨意照管他們；不是出於勉強，乃是出於甘心；也不是因為貪財，乃是出於樂意；
not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
Not as lords over God's heritage, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
也不是轄制所託付你們的，乃是作群羊的榜樣。
And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
And at the coming of the chief Keeper of the sheep, you will be given the eternal crown of glory.
到了牧長顯現的時候，你們必得那永不衰殘的榮耀冠冕。
Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

And in the same way, let the younger men be ruled by the older ones. Let all of you put away pride and make yourselves ready to be servants: for God is a hater of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low.
你們年幼的，也要順服年長的。就是你們眾人也都要以謙卑束腰，彼此順服；因為神阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
For this cause make yourselves low under the strong hand of God, so that when the time comes you may be lifted up;
所以，你們要自卑，服在神大能的手下，到了時候，他必叫你們升高。
Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
Putting all your troubles on him, for he takes care of you.
你們要將一切的憂慮卸給神，因為他顧念你們。
Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
Be serious and keep watch; the Evil One, who is against you, goes about like a lion with open mouth in search of food;
務要謹守，警醒。因為你們的仇敵魔鬼，如同吼叫的獅子，遍地遊行，尋找可吞吃的人。
Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
Do not give way to him but be strong in your faith, in the knowledge that your brothers who are in the world undergo the same troubles.
你們要用堅固的信心抵擋他，因為知道你們在世上的眾弟兄也是經歷這樣的苦難。
And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.

And after you have undergone pain for a little time, the God of all grace who has given you a part in his eternal glory through Christ Jesus, will himself give you strength and support, and make you complete in every good thing;
那賜諸般恩典的神曾在基督裡召你們，得享他永遠的榮耀，等你們暫受苦難之後，必要親自成全你們，堅固你們，賜力量給你們。
To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
His is the power for ever. So be it.
願權能歸給他，直到永永遠遠。阿們！
Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
I have sent you this short letter by Silvanus, a true brother, in my opinion; comforting you and witnessing that this is the true grace of God; keep to it.
我略略地寫了這信，託我所看為忠心的兄弟西拉轉交你們，勸勉你們，又證明這恩是神的真恩。你們務要在這恩上站立得住。
The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
She who is in Babylon, who has a part with you in the purpose of God, sends you her love; and so does my son Mark.
在巴比倫與你們同蒙揀選的教會問你們安。我兒子馬可也問你們安。
Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
Give one another the kiss of love. Peace be to you all in Christ.
你們要用愛心彼此親嘴問安。願平安歸與你們凡在基督裡的人！
